assetService.createIntent: declared mime checked against KIND_MIME_GROUPS, per-kind caps (UPLOAD_CAPS_BYTES), archives and Release-2 kinds refused, presigned PUT to quarantine/{tenant}/{intent} with SIGNED_URL/UPLOAD_INTENT TTLs; uploadIntentMachine issued → uploaded → quarantined → accepted|rejected. assets.integration.test.ts + cross-tenant (48/48).

storage.ts: StorageProvider interface, TenantPrefixedStorage template enforcing assertTenantKey on every operation (malformed/traversal and foreign-tenant keys → PolicyDeniedError), S3StorageProvider (AWS SDK v3, R2 via OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT, private buckets, presigned PUT/GET, releases bucket), MemoryStorageProvider, createStorageFromEnv fails closed in production. storage.test.ts (8) + module integration on the memory provider. assetIngestWorkflowV1 step 1: verify object exists and size ≤ cap

assetIngestWorkflowV1 step 2: content sniffing (file-type) authoritative over declared type
sniffType: file-type magic + font magic + SVG-by-content is authoritative; declared-mime mismatch, kind/content mismatch, archives and unaccepted formats rejected (steps.test.ts).
assetIngestWorkflowV1 step 3: malware scan (ClamAV or managed scanner)

ingest/scanner.ts: ClamAvScanner (clamd zINSTREAM over TCP, chunked, socket timeout), FakeScanner (EICAR), FailClosedScanner; no verdict → ScannerUnavailableError → Temporal retries → intent stays quarantined, never accepted; production without SCANNER_CLAMD_ADDRESS fails closed (scanner.test.ts 5, workflow test). Open: not run against a live clamd.
assetIngestWorkflowV1 step 4: sanitise SVG (scripts/external refs), parse fonts in sandbox, strip EXIF GPS, normalise orientation, record colour profile

sanitise: SVG entity/DOCTYPE pre-check, DOMPurify SVG profile with fragment-only URI regexp, unsafe removals → reject svg_unsafe_content, external url()/@import → reject, PNG preview, pixel budget by intrinsic size; images: header dimensions checked before decode, sharp re-encode drops EXIF/GPS, HEIC/AVIF converted; fonts: fontkit parse, collections rejected, family/licence metadata recorded in provenance; PDF header check. steps.test.ts + integration end-to-end.
assetIngestWorkflowV1 step 5: SHA-256 dedupe within brand (propose link, never silently merge)

hashAndDedupe: SHA-256 over the sanitised bytes; a duplicate within the brand ends the intent rejected with rejectionReason duplicate_of and resultAssetId = the existing asset (the link proposal); no second asset row. Integration test.
derivatives: thumbnail 256 / preview 1024 / web 2048 WebP without enlargement, written under the asset/version prefix; asset_derivatives rows insert-only. Unit + integration.
assetIngestWorkflowV1 step 7–8: move original to immutable path; catalogue row pending_review/approved

moveToImmutable copies quarantine → assets/{tenant}/{brand}/{asset}/{version}/original then deletes; catalogueAsset commits asset + version + derivatives + intent acceptance + audit + outbox asset.ingested in one transaction; autoApprove decided by policy.decide(actor, asset.approve) at the point of effect and passed explicitly. Activities integration (MockActivityEnvironment).

KIND_MIME_GROUPS / UPLOAD_CAPS_BYTES / ARCHIVE_MIMES / KINDS_NOT_PROCESSABLE in contracts; createIntent and sniffType enforce them (unit + integration).

assetService.setRights upserts usage_rights (owner, licence, permitted channels, territories, expiry, releases, restrictions) and moves rightsState → recorded; eligibility.ts rightsRequired/rightsExpiryThreshold (eligibility.test.ts 6, integration).

asset_grants (cross-brand within a tenant, per purpose; createGrant verifies target brands via brandService.assertExist → foreign tenant NOT_FOUND) and asset_usages (recordUsage, listUsages insert-only). Integration + cross-tenant.
findEligibleAssets: filter before ranking (brand or grant, approved, rights, expiry, kind)

assetService.findEligibleAssets: SQL filter tenant ∧ (brand ∨ active grant for purpose) ∧ approved ∧ kind ∧ rights presence/expiry, then the pure evaluateEligibility rule per row (channels, territory, scheduledFor + 24 h processing window) before ranking; pending, expired, wrong-kind, other-brand-without-grant, rights-unknown, retired and expired-grant assets never returned (assets.integration.test.ts).

authoriseUse re-runs evaluateEligibility at apply (creative, by purpose), at render (activities/render-job.ts) and at dispatch (review registerAssetAuthoriser → assets_rights_valid); an ineligible asset holds the publication (review.integration.test.ts).
Delivery: private buckets; 5-minute signed URLs via a media endpoint that re-checks authorisation

assets.media.signedUrl: private buckets, 300 s signed GET minted by the media endpoint after visibility + policy checks (SIGNED_URL_TTL_SEC); integration + cross-tenant. Live-bucket caveat recorded under 2.12.
Release derivatives minted at dispatch with provider processing-window lifetime

assetService.releaseExport re-reads the export bytes, re-hashes them against the approval-pinned contentHash, copies to releases/<tenant>/<brand>/<export>/export/<nonce> and signs a GET for the provider processing window (audit asset.release_minted); registered as the publishing media source in both compositions. apps/worker-core/src/publish-media.integration.test.ts.
Templates and template versions (slots, constraints, formats)

templates + template_versions: creativeService.templates.{create,createVersion,approve,list,get}; templateVersionMachine (draft → approved → retired) and templateMachine (draft → active → retired); documents pin specific versions; applyTemplate refuses unapproved versions and authorises the template page's assets (creative.integration.test.ts). Open: slot semantics beyond page replacement, and feeding eligibleTemplateVersionIds into the brand snapshot.
Attack fixtures: malformed SVG/font/image, decompression bombs, oversized input, SSRF/redirect chains

Attack fixtures generated in tests and rejected with typed reasons: SVG with script / onload / external xlink:href / @import url(http…) / <!ENTITY> → svg_unsafe_content; 40000×40000 SVG and a PNG whose IHDR declares 40000×40000 → pixel_limit_exceeded before decode; garbage/truncated font → font_unparsable; TTC → font_collection_unsupported; truncated PNG, declared-mime mismatch, zip → rejected; EICAR → malware_detected; unreachable scanner → quarantined. End-to-end: a script SVG upload ends rejected, quarantine object deleted, no asset rows.

phases.title: Creative studio
gate: Server: create → apply → get returns the committed snapshot; undo is a new revision with the earlier content hash (creative.integration.test.ts). Studio: create → edit → autosave → reload → same text, undo/redo produce new revisions (studio e2e, mock transport and real API).
Stale edits return 409 and the client rebases

Server returns STALE_REVISION (409, now with the matching transport code) carrying the current revision id; the studio rebases non-conflicting local intents onto the new head and shows a conflict dialog for same-element edits (studio e2e both modes; reducer tests).
Protected elements are immune to agent operations

guardProtected runs per operation in applyOperations; agent batches touching protected elements are PolicyDeniedError(protected_element) with nothing written; agents cannot insert logos; origin cannot be spoofed by a service principal. creative.integration.test.ts.
The export file approved in review is byte-identical (same hash) to the file handed to the provider

Export hash = sha256 of the stored bytes, re-verified on read and byte-identical across renders (golden and e2e tests); the approval binding pins the export hashes; at dispatch the publishing media source re-hashes the bytes against the pinned hash before minting the release URL and a mismatch holds the publication with export_hash_mismatch (apps/worker-core/src/publish-media.integration.test.ts).
items: packages/editor schema re-export of CreativeDocumentV1 (no HTML/SVG/script in the schema)
packages/editor/src/schema.ts re-exports the contracts schema under the spec names; no HTML/SVG/script in the schema
Pure reducer for all 13 operations; property tests (round-trip, stable IDs)

packages/editor/src/reduce.ts: pure reducer for all thirteen operations (structural errors as stable codes); reduce.test.ts covers purity, stable ids, round-trip undo, z-order, applyTemplate resolution, format variants; 17 editor tests pass
EditorAdapter interface (mount, onIntent, applyRemote, select, destroy)
packages/editor/src/adapter.ts: EditorAdapter / EditorHandle (mount, onIntent, applyRemote, select, destroy)
Konva/react-konva adapter with state outside the stage

packages/editor/src/konva-adapter.ts: KonvaEditorAdapter implements EditorAdapter with state outside the stage; gestures become operation batches (move/nudge/resize with logo aspect kept/transform/select; text edited in the side field); scene built by the shared buildScene with colourFor and ready(). 8 DOM-free unit tests of the intent mapping; exercised end to end by the studio e2e suite (12) in Chromium.
applyOperations: tenant-scoped load, policy assert, stale revision → 409

packages/modules/creative/src/service.ts operations.apply: document row lock (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), policy.assert creative.edit, currentRevisionId ≠ baseRevisionId → StaleRevisionError carrying the head (409). Tests: stale apply rejected and succeeds after rebase; two concurrent applies → exactly one commits.
applyOperations: guardProtected (agents cannot touch protected elements)

guardProtected + guardLogoInsertion run per operation inside applyOperations; an agent batch touching a protected element or inserting a logo is PolicyDeniedError (protected_element / agent_logo_insert) with nothing written; a service principal must submit origin agent (origin_mismatch). creative.integration.test.ts.
applyOperations: guardAssets via assets.authoriseUse for every referenced asset version

Every asset version an operation introduces (image/logo/background layers → purpose creative, text fonts and setStyle font patches → purpose font, replaceAsset, addPage, applyTemplate pages) goes through the registered authoriser; composition wires assetService.authoriseUse. RightsIneligibleError aborts the apply with nothing written; an unregistered authoriser fails loudly. Tests in creative.integration.test.ts.
applyOperations: validateAgainstBrand (tokens, logo rules, min sizes, contrast); agent proposals must be clean

validateAgainstBrand runs on the reduced snapshot in apply, propose and documents.create; blocking findings reject agent batches (ValidationFailedError, nothing written) and are returned as findings to people. creative.integration.test.ts.
applyOperations: revision create, setCurrentRevision (optimistic), comments marked outdated, outbox event, approval invalidation

Revision insert (parent, number + 1, brandVersionId, operations batch, snapshot, hashCanonical content hash, author kind/id, agentRunId, summary), setCurrentRevision with optimistic version, comments.markOutdatedFor(changedElementIds), outbox creative.revision_created, revision-change hook (approvals, Phase 5) and audit in one transaction; every revision records its brand version (asserted on rows).
operations.propose: dry-run with preview render and diff; accept / modify / reject

operations.propose: same stale check, guards, reduce and validation with no writes; returns {baseRevisionId, snapshot, contentHash, findings, changedElementIds, blocking} for the overlay diff. Open: the preview render of a proposal (rendering is asynchronous through render jobs).
Undo as a new revision; history never rewritten

Undo applies the inverse operations as a new batch: the new revision's content hash equals the earlier revision's, numbers only increase, revisions.list shows the full chain (creative.integration.test.ts "undo is a new revision…").

comments.add/resolve/list on element anchors; an open comment on an element becomes outdated when that element changes and untouched comments stay open; resolve is version-checked (CONFLICT on a stale version). creative.integration.test.ts.
Render worker: headless Chromium, render-only bundle of the same renderer, pinned fonts, manifest, PNG/JPEG/PDF

packages/editor/src/renderer (scene.ts is the one Konva scene builder for studio and worker; entry.ts exposes window.__oremediaRender; version.ts pins RENDERER_VERSION) bundled by tsup to renderer.iife.js (454 KB). apps/worker-render/src/chromium-renderer.ts loads it in headless Chromium with fonts and assets injected as data URLs from the object store; resolveRenderInputs builds the manifest (renderer version, every font and asset version with its sha256) and renderFormat re-hashes every input against it (RenderIntegrityError on mismatch). Integration: worker e2e 4/4, activities 7/7.
Deterministic render checks: overflow, missing font/asset, logo distortion > 0.5 %, clear space, min size, contrast AA, safe areas, size/dimension limits

packages/editor/src/checks.ts runRenderChecks: text overflow (measured), missing font/asset/colour, logo distortion > 0.5 %, logo clear space and minimum size (reused from validateAgainstBrand), contrast against the computed background (WCAG AA; contrast_unverified over images), safe area from measured rotated boxes, format mismatch, dimension and file-size limits (optional provider limits). checks.test.ts (9). Provider limits are wired at dispatch (Phase 5).
Render isolation: no credentials, egress only to object store, per-job limits, fresh browser context

Fresh offline browser context per render with every route aborted (no egress; inputs are data URLs), no credentials in the worker, RENDER_CONCURRENCY / MEDIA_CONCURRENCY, hard per-job timeout (RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS) and maxEdgePx; worker-render hosts the render and media queues only. Network isolation at the platform layer is documented in infra/railway/README.md and the runbook.
Golden renders: two fixture brands with different scripts/fonts; ≤ 0.1 % pixel difference

Two fixture brands with different scripts and pinned OFL fonts (Karla Latin; Noto Naskh Arabic RTL) covering wrapping, justify, RTL, transparency, rotation, crop and masks, a 4000×3000 image with focal point; committed goldens in tooling/test-fixtures/golden. golden.integration.test.ts: worker vs golden 0.0000 % differing pixels for both, web path (bundle on a visible stage, Playwright screenshot) vs worker export 0.0000 %, byte-identical PNGs in two fresh contexts (hash stability). Per-channel tolerance 2 implemented faithfully. CJK fixture deferred (Noto Sans SC exceeds the fixture size budget). Chromium is pinned through Playwright 1.56.1 (build 1194) in the worker, the CI job and the production image, and the worker always launches the full build (the headless shell drifts by ~3 %); bumping the pin means regenerating the goldens.

reflow() in packages/editor/src/reduce.ts: anchored elements keep margins, others scale by the smaller axis ratio with aspect preserved, text sizes scale with the same factor; tests check aspect ratio, anchors and schema validity
Studio layout: header context, left panels, canvas, right conversation/properties, bottom format strip, save state

apps/web/src/features/studio: header with company and brand, left panels (assets, templates, layers), centre canvas, right conversation placeholder + selected-element properties, bottom page/format strip, save/revision indicator and a review action disabled with its reason until Phase 5. Portfolio, brand home, brand system, asset library, sign-in and placeholder routes per spec 21.1; Vite build 641 KB main (195 KB gzip). Studio e2e 12/12 (mock transport) and 10/10 + 2 skipped against the real API.
Keyboard path for every canvas action; visible focus; screen-reader labels

Layers listbox with roving focus, arrow-key nudge 1 px / 10 px with Shift, Delete, Escape, Ctrl+Z/Y/S, numeric x/y/w/h fields, text edited in the side field, managed focus on page and proposal changes, aria labels on layers and properties, status never colour-only (glyph + text). Nudge path verified in e2e; the rest by inspection.
Pending batch on debounce; rebase on STALE_REVISION; conflicts shown

Pending batch flushed on 800 ms idle or explicit save; STALE_REVISION → fetch head and revisions since base → rebaseBatch → re-apply as a new intent; same-element conflicts shown in an alertdialog naming the elements with "keep theirs, re-apply the rest" / "discard all". Studio reducer tests + e2e (mock and real API).
Agent proposals as overlay diff with Accept / Modify / Reject

phases.title: Review and publication
gate: An approved revision publishes: scheduled → dispatching → published with an attempt row, sentAt, remote evidence and the release checks recorded (publishing.integration.test.ts; worker-core e2e with the outbox routing the start to task queue core).
Direct edits of text, alt text, settings, an added export, or a new published brand version each fail approval_matches and hold dispatch with that reason (review.integration.test.ts).

Disabling the approver's membership or removing the reviewer role fails approver_still_authorised; restoring it allows again; a revoked external reviewer link fails the same check (review.integration.test.ts).
Crash-after-send produces outcome_unknown and reconciles without a duplicate
Crash after sentAt → outcome_unknown → reconciliation finds the remote post and marks published with evidence; the fixture provider records exactly one remote post (module test and worker-core e2e).
Two outbox deliveries of the same publication.scheduled start the same workflow id once (USE_EXISTING); one attempt, one publication (worker-core e2e).
The cancel race behaves as specified

Cancel before the claim → cancelled; during dispatch → { prevented: false } and the signal cancels before the attempt opens; after send → not honoured, publication completes (module, workflow and e2e tests).

review.requests.create freezes FrozenManifestV1 + manifestHash; packages.revise marks the open request stale (staleReason package_revised, review.request_stale event), decisions on a stale request or wrong manifest hash are refused. review.integration.test.ts

External reviewer links: single-use per session, expiring, revocable, bound to one request, magic-link verification, separate origin

cancel: scheduled → cancelled race-safe; dispatching returns { prevented: false } and signals; cancelIfNotStarted honoured before the attempt opens, never after send. publishing.integration.test.ts, publication.workflow.v1.test.ts, worker-core e2e

reschedule updates the row and emits the reschedule signal (relay workflow); the durable wait wakes; nothing terminates an in-flight workflow. publishing.integration.test.ts, workflow unit test

outbox-dispatcher.ts: lease-based claim (UPDATE … LIMIT with deadlock retry), jittered backoff capped 15 min, stable workflow ids with USE_EXISTING + ALLOW_DUPLICATE_FAILED_ONLY, dead letters at ≥ 5 attempts with replay (operations.outbox.replay), failure path keyed on this worker's live claim, gauges. outbox-dispatcher.integration.test.ts
publicationWorkflowV1: durable wait re-reading the row; claim with fencing token; release evaluation at dispatch; attempt row before send; publishOnce with maximumAttempts 1; outcome switch

Workflow inputs and activity payloads carry channelConnectionId only; credentials are resolved inside publish activities on worker-core (contracts/publishing.ts, publish-provider.ts).
